revenue.locator: Consolidated Statements of Income; Total net revenue, fiscal year or six-month columns.

operatingIncome.locator: Consolidated Statements of Income; Operating income, fiscal year or six-month columns. Includes DFS financing income; financing interest expense is below operating income.

cashAndEquivalents.locator: Consolidated Statements of Financial Position; Cash and cash equivalents. Restricted cash excluded.

shortTermInvestments.locator: Consolidated Statements of Financial Position: no separate current investment balance; Note Investments places investment portfolio in long-term investments. Financing receivables are operating assets, not securities.

longTermInvestments.locator: Consolidated Statements of Financial Position; Long-term investments. Investment fair-value gains are in Interest and other, net below operating income.

debtCurrent.locator: Consolidated Statements of Financial Position; Short-term debt. Includes DFS securitization and other customer-finance borrowings. Annual Note Leases states no material finance leases as lessee.

debtNoncurrent.locator: Consolidated Statements of Financial Position; Long-term debt. All corporate and DFS borrowings retained; debt carrying amount, not principal.

operatingLeaseLiabilities.locator: Note Leases; total operating lease liabilities (current plus non-current). Operating leases are not added to financing debt.

noncontrollingInterest.locator: Consolidated Statements of Financial Position; no remaining non-controlling interest following Secureworks disposal. Annual column explicitly zero.

preferredEquity.locator: Note Capitalization; no shares of preferred stock issued or outstanding.

sharesOutstanding.locator: Note Capitalization; actual period-end common shares outstanding, all classes: annual A 277 + B 52 + C 323 = 652; July A 277 + B 44 + C 319 = 640 million. Excludes treasury shares; not weighted-average EPS denominator.

unvestedRSUs.locator: FY2026 Note 16 Stock-based compensation; outstanding 19 million RSU/PSU units, comprising 14 million RSUs and 5 million PSUs at target. PSU vesting can be 0%-200%.

options.count.locator: FY2026 Note 16 Stock Option Activity; September 30 2025 COO award, 2.5 million options, ten-year term. No other material option activity identified.

options.weightedExercisePrice.locator: FY2026 Note 16 Stock Option Activity; COO option exercise price $141.77.

options.weightedRemainingYears.locator: No weighted remaining-life table disclosed; grant has ten-year contractual term from September 30 2025. Derived term used only in separately labelled claims policy.

options.aggregateIntrinsicValue.locator: No period-end option aggregate intrinsic value disclosed; no market intrinsic deduction is made.

otherClaims.locator: FY2026 Note 17 Retirement plan benefits: international plan obligations 498 minus plan assets 250 = underfunded position 248, recognized in other non-current liabilities. U.S. plan settled during FY2026.

annual.note: USD millions; common shares in millions. Whole-enterprise FCFF includes customer-finance income in revenue and all consolidated financing debt. DFS borrowing interest is in Interest and other, net below EBIT, so no interest addback or DFS debt exclusion is needed. Financing receivables and leased customer equipment remain operating assets; do not add them as surplus assets. Strategic-investment gains are below EBIT and investments are added once at carrying value. Annual filing reports no material finance leases as lessee. Share counts are rounded millions as filed, all classes included. Stock compensation stays in expenses. Employee awards are separate ownership claims; options use a separately labelled full-vesting value proxy, not the reported $132m grant-date expense value. Supplier finance remains ordinary trade payables as classified in the filing and is not deducted again. Annual international pension shortfall is included once outside borrowing debt.
